title: Understanding Principal Components
text: Principal components are orthogonal to each other. This means that the dot product of any two different principal components should be zero.

title: Orthogonality of Principal Components
text: Since principal components are orthogonal, their dot product is zero. If the dot product is greater than zero, it indicates that they are not orthogonal.
